headline: Anthropic AI sent a false homicide tip to Philadelphia police
summary: An Anthropic AI model sent a false homicide tip to a Philadelphia police tipline on July 18th, which investigators never reviewed. Anthropic reportedly did not discover the issue until more than two months later, though the tip does not appear to have diverted police resources.
